notes:
MERGED (repair sa-04-a, 2026-10-19): this dossier now carries kingdom-of-dambadeniya as well. Cliopatria draws one Sinhalese realm as two rows, 'Kingdom of Dambadeniya' (1236-1293, 5,219 km2 round Kurunegala) and 'Ceylon' (1236-1506), which tile (0 cells overlap; Ceylon has a hole at Kurunegala to 1293); the reviewer failed both dossiers for being one state in two. Slug ceylon was kept (the longer Cliopatria row, the slug other dossiers use as counterpart); the state starts in 1220 (Dambadeniya infobox, 'Fall of Polonnaruwa: 1220'); both Names are listed in cliopatria_names and every shape of both rows is reviewed (kingdom-of-dambadeniya_1220 is a new keyframe). The file kingdom-of-dambadeniya.json is superseded and should be deleted by the orchestrator (the author's delete was refused by the permission system); it carries a SUPERSEDED notice meanwhile. kingdom-of-polonnaruwa (sa-03) still lists kingdom-of-dambadeniya as a successor: it should say ceylon. The single Pandya occupation 1284-1309 names ceylon (as pandya-empire does). Other changes: the 1236 'found' is now a gain from nobody and the Polonnaruwa gain moved from 1244 to 1236 (the Polonnaruwa page has Magha expelled in 1236); capitals for 1288-1309 and the 1310 move added.

ORIGINAL NOTES OF THE CEYLON DOSSIER: Cliopatria's 'Ceylon' row (1236-1506, Wikipedia title 'Sri Lanka', Wikidata Q918153) is NOT the same state as British Ceylon (1796-1814), which shares the Wikidata id only because both are the island; they are different states, so this dossier lists only 'Ceylon' in cliopatria_names. WHAT THE ROW IS: the Sinhalese kingdom drawn round the island, with a hole at Kurunegala where Cliopatria's separate Dambadeniya row sits (1236-1293); after 1293 one shape. The pages (Dambadeniya, Parakramabahu II, Gampola, Kotte) trace one line of kings by capital: Dambadeniya, Yapahuwa, Polonnaruwa (1302-1310), Kurunegala (1310-1345), Gampola (1341/1345-1411), Kotte (1412-). It is treated here as one state (rule 2) with a rename at 1412. Pages opened: 6 (five for this state and the Pandya Empire page, opened for pandya-empire, which dates the end of Pandya control). DISAGREEMENTS: Gampola 1341 vs 1345; Kotte 1412 vs 1415; Magha's expulsion 1236 (Polonnaruwa dossier) vs 'by 1244'; the Pandya invasion 1254-1256 (Parakramabahu II) vs 1258 and 1262-1264 (Pandya Empire, Jaffna); Aryacakravarti installed 1262 vs 1277. NOT SETTLED: no page dates the loss (1314) and regaining (1352) of the northern plains, so both events are confidence 1; the capital for 1284-1301 is not on the page; the page for Kotte does not mention territory and the Kandy rebellion's extent is my reading; the Alagakkonara-Aryacakravarti war and Zheng He's 1411 intervention are undated or only noted. Portuguese Ceylon (Cliopatria 1507) is the successor; the Kotte state lasts to 1597, so the portuguese-ceylon owner may want to treat 1507-1597 as Kotte under Portuguese protection. States that need dossiers: the Kandyan kingdom of Senkadagala (1469-1815, Cliopatria lacks it). Mirrors: jaffna-kingdom (sa-04, another part) should carry the 1260 and 1352 gains and the 1314 loss from this row, Kotte's 1450-1467 hold, Pandya vassalage 1258-1323; pandya-empire carries the occupation. Gazetteer: 'Yapahuwa', 'Dambadeniya' not in the gazetteer.

ORIGINAL NOTES OF THE DAMBADENIYA DOSSIER (now merged): Pages opened: 2 of 2 (Kingdom of Dambadeniya; Parakramabahu II of Dambadeniya). WHAT THE ROW IS: Cliopatria draws the Dambadeniya country (5,219 km2, Kurunegala) as one row for 1236-1293 and the rest of the island's Sinhalese realm as a different row, 'Ceylon' (ceylon dossier), which has a hole exactly where this row sits (0 cells overlap) and absorbs it from 1294: one realm drawn as two rows. The orchestrator may want the two dossiers merged or given one colour family. START AND END: the infobox runs the kingdom 1220-1345; this dossier starts in 1220 (the infobox) and ends in 1293 (Cliopatria's last year), so 1220-1235 is a new keyframe and 1294-1345 (Yapahuwa to 1283, Polonnaruwa 1302-1310, Kurunegala 1310-1345) is carried by the ceylon dossier. NOT SETTLED: the page's own dates conflict (Parakramabahu II 1234-1269 infobox vs 1236-1270 text; Yapahuwa 1271 vs 1273; Bhuvanekabahu I 1271-1283 vs 1272-1284; Parakramabahu III 1302-1310 vs 1287-1293); the page gives no territory, so the 5,219 km2 outline is unverified: page budget; the Polonnaruwa page dates Vijayabahu III's Dambadeniya to 1232, which the page does not support. Gazetteer: 'Yapahuwa' and 'Dambadeniya' are not in the gazetteer (the Cliopatria outline is used). Mirrors: pandya-empire carries the 1284-c.1309 occupation; kingdom-of-polonnaruwa lists this state as a successor of 1236.

Thin findings tried (sa-04-a repair): the Alakeshvara page has no date for the 1314 loss or the 1352 regaining of the northern plains (they stay confidence 1) but dates the Aryacakravarti invasions of Gampola (1360, 1369), added as a war; the Portuguese Ceylon page has the Portuguese arrival in 1505 and Dharmapala of Kotte's death on 27 May 1597 and nothing on Kotte's status in 1506, so the 1506 end stays a Cliopatria year (confidence 1); the capital gap of 1284-1301 is filled from the Dambadeniya page (relic at Polonnaruwa 1288).
